purpose: Run a new human, non-pathogen, non-metal-dependent exploratory receptor-ensemble replication on PPARG after the DPP4 branch was terminated by user preference and the PARP1 structural-pool gate was closed before docking.
evidence_timing: Frozen after public DUD-E target-page counts, label-independent RCSB metadata feasibility screening, and PPARG source-identity inspection. No PPARG coordinate-pool selection, receptor preparation, redocking, production docking, QUBO fitting, validation metric, or test metric has been read or run at this freeze.

dpp4.termination_reason: user preference for a different non-toxic protein target

parp1.termination_reason: the DUD-E reference is a V762A mutant and the strict wild-type catalytic-domain metadata pool contains only 11 candidates, below the 24-candidate requirement

prior_branch_record.replacement_status: PPARG is a new preregistered exploratory extension. It does not alter, repair, or erase earlier confirmatory-gate records.

selection_criteria: ordinary noncovalent small-molecule complexes without a required catalytic metal or covalent scoring mechanism
at least 480 clustered DUD-E actives supporting a scaffold-disjoint train, fresh-validation, and locked-test allocation
at least 24 public wild-type X-ray structures satisfying label-independent metadata criteria

ligand_panel.split_group: Bemis-Murcko scaffold joined with duplicate source IDs before allocation
ligand_panel.rationale_for_train_count: PPARG has 484, rather than at least 498, clustered DUD-E actives. Fresh-validation and locked-test panels retain 75 actives each; the development-training panel uses the remaining 334 actives.
ligand_panel.failure_action: Stop PPARG before receptor production docking if all 484 source active molecules cannot be assigned to molecule-, source-, canonical-SMILES-, and scaffold-disjoint panels.

receptor_protocol.coordinate_selection_data: coordinates and metadata only; activity labels and benchmark docking scores prohibited
receptor_protocol.pre_redocking_selection: deterministic max-min active-site geometry with the DUD-E reference included
receptor_protocol.post_redocking_final_selection: from passing candidates, deterministically select 16 by max-min active-site geometry; no activity labels or benchmark scores
receptor_protocol.failure_action: If fewer than 16 of 24 candidates pass the fixed redocking gate, report a PPARG technical failure without adding structures after reading enrichment results.

production_protocol.score_aggregation: median across seeds per receptor-ligand pair; selected receptor subsets use min_score

interpretation_boundary: PPARG can provide prospective exploratory evidence for receptor-ensemble and QUBO behavior on a human nuclear receptor. It cannot erase earlier target records, retroactively satisfy the original three-target confirmatory gate, establish quantum advantage, or establish experimental binding.
